name: Fique de Pé
storyline: The lights come up, the audience cheers and the host calls the contestants to a round stage. Each one stands over a closed trapdoor. Every wrong answer can open the floor, and the show goes on until a single contestant is left standing.
summary: Fique de Pé is a 3D multiplayer quiz game styled as a Brazilian TV game show, played in the web browser. Up to twelve contestants stand on a round stage, each one over a trapdoor, and answer trivia questions against the clock while a host and a cheering studio audience follow every move. A wrong answer or a run-out timer opens the floor and the contestant drops out of the show, and the last one standing takes the prize. It offers several game modes, to play alone or with a full room, and streamers can bring their own Twitch chat into the studio as the audience.
